import requests, numpy as np, pandas as pd, json, time
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

# ---------- BLOSUM62 + vectorized NW (self-contained) ----------
B62_txt = """   A  R  N  D  C  Q  E  G  H  I  L  K  M  F  P  S  T  W  Y  V
A  4 -1 -2 -2  0 -1 -1  0 -2 -1 -1 -1 -1 -2 -1  1  0 -3 -2  0
R -1  5  0 -2 -3  1  0 -2  0 -3 -2  2 -1 -3 -2 -1 -1 -3 -2 -3
N -2  0  6  1 -3  0  0  0  1 -3 -3  0 -2 -3 -2  1  0 -4 -2 -3
D -2 -2  1  6 -3  0  2 -1 -1 -3 -4 -1 -3 -3 -1  0 -1 -4 -3 -3
C  0 -3 -3 -3  9 -3 -4 -3 -3 -1 -1 -3 -1 -2 -3 -1 -1 -2 -2 -1
Q -1  1  0  0 -3  5  2 -2  0 -3 -2  1  0 -3 -1  0 -1 -2 -1 -2
E -1  0  0  2 -4  2  5 -2  0 -3 -3  1 -2 -3 -1  0 -1 -3 -2 -2
G  0 -2  0 -1 -3 -2 -2  6 -2 -4 -4 -2 -3 -3 -2  0 -2 -2 -3 -3
H -2  0  1 -1 -3  0  0 -2  8 -3 -3 -1 -2 -1 -2 -1 -2 -2  2 -3
I -1 -3 -3 -3 -1 -3 -3 -4 -3  4  2 -3  1  0 -3 -2 -1 -3 -1  3
L -1 -2 -3 -4 -1 -2 -3 -4 -3  2  4 -2  2  0 -3 -2 -1 -2 -1  1
K -1  2  0 -1 -3  1  1 -2 -1 -3 -2  5 -1 -3 -1  0 -1 -3 -2 -2
M -1 -1 -2 -3 -1  0 -2 -3 -2  1  2 -1  5  0 -2 -1 -1 -1 -1  1
F -2 -3 -3 -3 -2 -3 -3 -3 -1  0  0 -3  0  6 -4 -2 -2  1  3 -1
P -1 -2 -2 -1 -3 -1 -1 -2 -2 -3 -3 -1 -2 -4  7 -1 -1 -4 -3 -2
S  1 -1  1  0 -1  0  0  0 -1 -2 -2  0 -1 -2 -1  4  1 -3 -2 -2
T  0 -1  0 -1 -1 -1 -1 -2 -2 -1 -1 -1 -1 -2 -1  1  5 -2 -2  0
W -3 -3 -4 -4 -2 -2 -3 -2 -2 -3 -2 -3 -1  1 -4 -3 -2 11  2 -3
Y -2 -2 -2 -3 -2 -1 -2 -3  2 -1 -1 -2 -1  3 -3 -2 -2  2  7 -1
V  0 -3 -3 -3 -1 -2 -2 -3 -3  3  1 -2  1 -1 -2 -2  0 -3 -1  4"""
rb=B62_txt.strip().split("\n"); AAs=rb[0].split(); AIDX={a:i for i,a in enumerate(AAs)}
MAT=np.full((21,21),-4.0)
for ln in rb[1:]:
    f=ln.split()
    for j,v in enumerate(f[1:]): MAT[AIDX[f[0]],AIDX[AAs[j]]]=float(v)
def enc(s): return np.array([AIDX.get(c,20) for c in s])
NEG=-1e9
def nw(s1,s2,go=-11.0,ge=-1.0):
    e1,e2=enc(s1),enc(s2); n,m=len(s1),len(s2)
    M=np.full((n+1,m+1),NEG);X=np.full((n+1,m+1),NEG);Y=np.full((n+1,m+1),NEG)
    M[0,0]=0.0; X[1:,0]=go+ge*np.arange(n); Y[0,1:]=go+ge*np.arange(m)
    jj=np.arange(m+1)
    for i in range(1,n+1):
        sub=MAT[e1[i-1],e2]
        M[i,1:]=np.maximum.reduce([M[i-1,:-1],X[i-1,:-1],Y[i-1,:-1]])+sub
        X[i,1:]=np.maximum.reduce([M[i-1,1:]+go,X[i-1,1:]+ge,Y[i-1,1:]+go])
        base=np.maximum(M[i,:],X[i,:])+go-ge*jj
        run=np.maximum.accumulate(base); Y[i,1:]=ge*jj[1:]+run[:-1]
    i,j=n,m; st=int(np.argmax([M[n,m],X[n,m],Y[n,m]])); a1=[];a2=[]
    while i>0 or j>0:
        if i==0: st=2
        elif j==0: st=1
        if st==0:
            a1.append(s1[i-1]);a2.append(s2[j-1]); st=int(np.argmax([M[i-1,j-1],X[i-1,j-1],Y[i-1,j-1]])); i-=1;j-=1
        elif st==1:
            a1.append(s1[i-1]);a2.append('-'); st=int(np.argmax([M[i-1,j]+go,X[i-1,j]+ge,Y[i-1,j]+go])); i-=1
        else:
            a1.append('-');a2.append(s2[j-1]); st=int(np.argmax([M[i,j-1]+go,X[i,j-1]+go,Y[i,j-1]+ge])); j-=1
    return "".join(reversed(a1)),"".join(reversed(a2))
def map_ref(ref,q):
    ar,aq=nw(ref,q); ri=qi=0; mp={}; ident=0; al=0
    for c1,c2 in zip(ar,aq):
        if c1!='-': ri+=1
        if c2!='-': qi+=1
        if c1!='-':
            if c2!='-': mp[ri]=(c2,qi); al+=1; ident+=(c1==c2)
            else: mp[ri]=('-',None)
    return mp, 100*ident/max(al,1)

def fetch(a):
    t=requests.get(f"https://rest.uniprot.org/uniprotkb/{a}.fasta",timeout=60).text
    return "".join(t.strip().split("\n")[1:])

REF=fetch("Q87VB1")  # PsSelO
KEY={91:('D','Gly-rich loop Asp'),93:('R','Arg93'),113:('K','VAIK Lys'),125:('D','Asp125'),
     136:('E','alphaC Glu'),176:('R','Arg176'),183:('R','Arg183'),
     252:('D','catalytic Asp'),253:('N','Mg Asn'),262:('D','DFG-like Mg Asp')}

# fungal panel, one per genus, length filter to avoid long fusion/mis-models
q='(xref:pfam-PF02696) AND (taxonomy_id:4751)'
r=requests.get("https://rest.uniprot.org/uniprotkb/search",
   params={"query":q,"size":500,"format":"json",
           "fields":"accession,organism_name,length,sequence,lineage"},timeout=120)
res=r.json()["results"]
panel={}
for e in res:
    org=e["organism"]["scientificName"]; gen=org.split()[0]
    L=e["sequence"]["length"]
    if gen in panel or L>1000 or L<400: continue
    panel[gen]=(e["primaryAccession"],org,e["sequence"]["value"])
panel=dict(list(panel.items())[:70])
# force-include the reference set
extra={"Schizosaccharomyces":("O13890","Schizosaccharomyces pombe",fetch("O13890")),
       "Saccharomyces":("Q08968","Saccharomyces cerevisiae",fetch("Q08968"))}
panel.update(extra)
print("panel size",len(panel))

rows=[]
t0=time.time()
for gen,(acc,org,s) in panel.items():
    mp,idp=map_ref(REF,s)
    d={"genus":gen,"acc":acc,"organism":org,"len":len(s),"pct_id_vs_PsSelO":round(idp,1)}
    for p,(wt,lab) in KEY.items():
        c,qpos=mp[p]
        d[f"{wt}{p}"]=f"{c}{qpos}" if qpos else "gap"
        d[f"ok_{wt}{p}"]=int(c==wt)
    rows.append(d)
df=pd.DataFrame(rows)
print("elapsed",round(time.time()-t0,1),"s")
okcols=[c for c in df.columns if c.startswith("ok_")]
df["n_conserved"]=df[okcols].sum(axis=1)
cons = df[okcols].mean().mul(100).round(1)
print("\nConservation of each PsSelO catalytic position across", len(df), "fungal SelO orthologs (one per genus):")
print(cons.to_string())
print("\nS. pombe sel0 row:")
print(df[df.genus=="Schizosaccharomyces"].T.to_string())
print("\nFraction of fungal orthologs retaining all 10 positions: %.1f%%"%(100*(df.n_conserved==10).mean()))
print("Fraction retaining the 6 core positions (D91,K113,D125,E136,D252,N253,D262):")
core=["ok_D91","ok_K113","ok_D125","ok_E136","ok_D252","ok_N253","ok_D262"]
print("  %.1f%%"%(100*(df[core].sum(axis=1)==7).mean()))
globals()['DF']=df
df.to_csv("/tmp/fungal_selo_panel.csv",index=False)

# figure
fig,ax=plt.subplots(figsize=(9,4.2))
order=[f"{wt}{p}" for p,(wt,lab) in sorted(KEY.items())]
vals=[cons[f"ok_{o}"] for o in order]
labels=[f"{o}\n{KEY[int(o[1:])][1]}" for o in order]
colors=["#2E7D32" if v>=95 else ("#F9A825" if v>=70 else "#C62828") for v in vals]
ax.bar(range(len(order)),vals,color=colors)
for i,v in enumerate(vals): ax.text(i,v+1.5,f"{v:.0f}",ha='center',fontsize=9)
ax.set_xticks(range(len(order))); ax.set_xticklabels(labels,fontsize=7.5)
ax.set_ylabel("% of fungal orthologs with identical residue")
ax.set_ylim(0,112)
ax.set_title(f"Conservation of PsSelO active-site residues across {len(df)} fungal SelO orthologs\n(positions defined by AMP-PNP / Mg2+ contacts in PDB 6EAC)",fontsize=10)
ax.axhline(100,ls=':',c='grey',lw=0.8)
plt.tight_layout(); plt.show()
